description: DBTL - P070302 - Nodo della rete elettrica is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.provincia.lodi.it. Information layer of the Topographic Database of the Province of Lodi. P070302, Power grid node. Node belonging to the power grid. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DBTL — P070302 — Power grid node" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include lodi, rete elettrica, database topografico, open data. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
